data.gender_notes: Thanaram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Thanaram is a combination of two Sanskrit words, Thana (god) and Aram (wisdom and power). This name signifies a god who embodies wisdom and power. The name Thanaram carries the meaning “God of Wisdom and Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Thanaram usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Thanaram is a sacred name for the Hindu deity who is believed to bestow wisdom and power upon his devotees.
data.etymology: Thanaram belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wisdom and Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Thanaram total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
